value.title: I dodici generali del Pugno Marziale
value.synopsis: A powerful new threat emerges when a violent and bold group of masked assailants attacks Tatsuma and his friends.

value.title: Urlo al Purgatorio
value.synopsis: While some of the gang hears details about the infamous Martial Fists, the rest of the team is learning about their new enemies the hard way -- engaged in amazingly fierce battle!

value.title: Cambiamo noi stessi
value.synopsis: As Daigo and Kyouichi deal with strange events in the present, scenes from the past reveal painful moments that shaped them into the young men they've become.

value.title: Il pugno non prende vita
value.synopsis: Kyouichi raises his new blade against Ukon. As the rest of the gang takes on swarms of mystical enemies, Tatsuma's reality is turned upside down by shocking revelations regarding his past.

value.title: Il pugno che protegge
value.synopsis: As the group tries to identify the one responsible for the recent madness, Tatsuma once again comes face-to-face with Marie -- and she wants him dead.

value.title: Storia di Byakko: una vigilia di Natale triste
value.synopsis: During the season of giving, Tatsuma is stunned beyond comprehension to find those closest to him brutally taken away by a murderous fiend known as Chaos.

value.title: Storia di Genbu: Caos
value.synopsis: With pain and madness in the winter air, Tatsuma must decide what kind of man he truly is when he gets his hands on the psychotic killer known as Chaos.

value.title: Storia di Suzaku: Giorno della distruzione
value.synopsis: Tatsuma's friends are worried he's spending too much time trying to help Ryuuji. But bigger concerns are on the horizon: An evil like no other is about to strike.

value.title: Storia di Seiryu: Stelle del destino
value.synopsis: The world is in serious danger as Yagyu delivers death to many in an incredibly brutal battle. Unless Tatsuma's team reaches unimaginable levels of power, the situation is truly hopeless.

value.title: Storia del drago d'oro: I fiori di ciliegio fioriscono
value.synopsis: The citizens of Tokyo come together to rebuild, and the wounded begin to heal. The gang reflects on all that was lost and ponders the mysterious fate of Tatsuma.

value.title: Camminate avanti, bambini
value.synopsis: A glimpse into the past reveals the friendships and struggles along the path undertaken by Tatsuma and his powerful friends.

value.title: Grazie
value.synopsis: Happy memories: Sometimes even those who fight to keep Tokyo safe from evil get a chance to live as normal high school kids.
